title: 第十九章 秋税 上第二十章 秋税 下
content_zh:
学武？
武学奇才？
在场的众人咀嚼着两个词语，总觉得怪怪的，好像如此人物不应该出现在义兴市里，至少不应该是在梁渠身上。
他是谁？
孤儿。
一个任何时代都异常沉重的身份。
除了卖身求条活路，绝大部分都成了乞丐，在某个冬天默默饿死。
梁家父子本就过得不好，不少邻居都对梁大江这个鳏夫的过世记忆犹新，死后不至于草席裹尸，但也仅买了一口薄皮棺材，草草埋在了后山，立了一块木碑。
梁大江捕鱼技术也相当一般，家中除了遗留下来的一艘好船，连张渔网都没有，身为其子的梁渠自然不会强到哪去。
唯一算得上好的，或许就是梁渠长得不错，可这世道，一个男娃子长得再好看，都不会有人会上门提亲，更吃不饱饭。
可瞧见狼狈逃窜的三兄弟，似乎只能这样解释。
大家面面相觑。
本以为梁渠最后的道路与那些孤儿无异，要么卖身，要么乞讨，没料到现在竟是与所有人想得不同，脱胎换骨一般。
先是捕鱼捕得好，每日鱼获都有近百文，后来更是一举抓到了宝鱼，还是好宝鱼，一条卖出两条的价，如今看来，那卖鱼得来的钱就是被他用来学武去了。
读书，练武，向来是普通人出人头地最好的两条路子。
读书暂且不论，学武，距离众人并不遥远，没见过也听过，可从来没听说乡里哪个人靠学武出人头地的。
学完回来帮自家占住河口，多浇两亩地，多捕两网鱼都做不到，白白糟践钱。
反倒是这梁渠，好似学出了名堂。
不管如何，能到今天这一步，都证明了梁渠与常人不太一样，有人开始出声恭维。
“阿水出息了，以后是要当老爷的人了。”

“真成了武师，可不要忘记我们这些邻居们呐。”
“是极是极，成了武师，我让我儿子也跟你学！”
梁渠望着众人的反应，并没有多高兴，只说是自己运道好。
说出自己习武的事，也只是不想再有无赖三天两头上门了，因此告诉大家两个信息。
一，我没钱了，都拿去练武交学费了。
二，我有学武的天赋，你们想来打秋风，先掂量掂量。
当然，还有一个目的，以后他的变化会越来越大，到时候别问，问就是习武。
什么，你问别人怎么没这番变化，别人有我这么优秀的根骨吗？
开头给大家种下一个天赋异禀的种子，后面离谱些，就不会太突兀。
等众人热闹散去，梁渠回到家中，搬开米缸，挖出埋在泥土中的银钱，确认一分没少后松了口气。
再过不久就要交秋税，要是没钱就麻瓜了。
好在托一条鞭法和摊丁入亩的福，要缴的税很简单，就是一个成年男子一两银子。
只不过缴纳白银成色不一，而标准是官银，就会出现火耗问题，这个火耗自然算在老百姓头上，实际缴税是一两三钱左右。
大顺十六成年，按理梁渠还差几个月，但懂的都懂，别说差几个月，差一年，你都是“十六”
只可惜，按理说一条鞭之下，直接交白银就好了，可江淮泽野一带的数个郡府还是要接着交粮食，供给皇室享用。
为此明天就该去买米了，否则涨价涨得厉害。
梁渠定好计划，将钱收入怀中，随后掏出一根树枝，在地上画了张表格，开始打拳。
通过表格记录成长，判断练功的最佳时间和最佳效率，是为科学炼体法。
content_en:
Learn martial arts?
Martial arts wizard?
Everyone present chewed on these two words, always feeling strange, as if such a person should not appear in Yixing City, at least not in Liang Qu.
who is he?
orphan.
An identity that is extremely heavy in any era.
In addition to selling themselves to find a way to survive, most of them became beggars and starved to death in silence one winter.
The Liang family and his son were not living well. Many neighbors still remember the death of Liang Dajiang, a widower. He did not wrap his body in a straw mat after his death, but they only bought a thin-skinned coffin and buried it in the back hill with a wooden monument.
Liang Dajiang's fishing skills are also quite average. Apart from a good boat left at home, he doesn't even have a fishing net. As his son, Liang Qu is naturally not much better.
The only thing that can be considered good is that Liang Qu is good-looking, but in this world, no matter how good-looking a boy is, no one will come to propose marriage, let alone have enough to eat.
But seeing the three brothers running away in embarrassment, the only explanation seemed to be this.
Everyone looked at each other.
I thought that Liang Qu's final path would be the same as that of those orphans, either selling himself or begging. Unexpectedly, he was different from what everyone thought, and he was completely reborn.
First, he fished well, and he caught nearly a hundred fish every day. Later, he caught a treasure fish in one fell swoop. It was a good treasure fish, and he sold one for two. Now it seems that the money he got from selling the fish was used by him to learn martial arts.
Studying and practicing martial arts have always been the two best ways for ordinary people to get ahead.
Leaving aside studying, learning martial arts is not far away from everyone. I have never seen or heard of it, but I have never heard of anyone in the village getting ahead by learning martial arts.
After studying, I came back to help my family occupy the mouth of the river, water two more acres of land, and catch two more fish. It was a waste of money.
On the contrary, Liang Qu seemed to have learned a lot.
No matter what, getting to this point proved that Liang Qu was different from ordinary people, and some people began to compliment him.
"Ah Shui has made his mark, he will be a master in the future."
"If you really become a martial artist, don't forget us neighbors."
"Yes, yes, if you become a martial artist, I will let my son learn from you!"
Liang Qu looked at everyone's reaction and was not very happy. He just said that he was lucky.
When I tell you about my martial arts practice, I just don’t want any more scoundrels to come to my door every three days, so I want to tell you two pieces of information.
One, I have no money, so I use it to practice martial arts and pay tuition fees.
Second, I have the talent to learn martial arts. If you want to come and compete in Qiufeng, you should consider it first.
Of course, there is another purpose. He will change more and more in the future. Don't ask when the time comes, just practice martial arts.
What, you ask others why they haven’t changed like this? Do others have such excellent foundation as me?
At the beginning, a seed of extraordinary talent is planted for everyone, and later on, it is more outrageous, so that it will not be too abrupt.
After the crowd dispersed, Liang Qu returned home, removed the rice jar, dug out the coins buried in the soil, and breathed a sigh of relief after confirming that not a penny was missing.
The autumn taxes will be paid soon, and if you don't have the money, you'll be a Muggle.
Fortunately, thanks to the whipping method and the ability to work as a farmer, the tax to be paid is very simple, just one tael of silver for an adult man.
It's just that the fineness of the silver paid is different, and the standard is official silver, there will be a problem of fire cost. This fire cost will naturally be counted on the common people, and the actual tax paid is about one, two or three yuan.
Dashun turns sixteen, and Liang Qu is still a few months away, but he understands everything. Not to mention a few months away, a year away, you are still "sixteen"
It's a pity that it stands to reason that with one whip, it would be enough to just hand over the silver, but several counties in the Jianghuai Zeye area still have to hand over grain for the royal family to enjoy.
For this reason, you should go buy rice tomorrow, otherwise the price will rise drastically.
Liang Qu made a plan, put the money in his arms, then took out a branch, drew a form on the ground, and started punching.
Use tables to record growth and determine the best time and best results for practicing.Rate is a scientific body-training method.
